Indian Rupee Reaches 10-Week High Against Dollar

The Indian Rupee strengthened to a 10-week high, closing at 94.59 against the US Dollar. This appreciation was attributed to a softer dollar internationally and inflows from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The currency reached 94.48 before closing at 94.59.
